shortBio.en: Megadeth lead guitar on Rust in Peace–era technical peak.
shortBio.zh: Rust in Peace 时期 Megadeth 技术巅峰主音吉他。

body.en: Joins for Rust in Peace. Fusion-leaning phrasing at thrash tempos. Leaves 2000; peak-cast identity stays tied to that album cycle.
body.zh: 为 Rust in Peace 加入。在 thrash 速度上偏融合的乐句。2000 离开；巅峰卡司身份仍绑在那一轮专辑。
